notes:
## Fixes

- **Covers keep their shape.** A cover the other way round to your tiles, such as a portrait screenshot on landscape tiles, is now shown whole with black bars at the sides, rather than cropped to a strip of its middle. A landscape cover on portrait tiles gets bars above and below. The cover beside an open folder's scenes does the same. Covers the same way round as the tiles fill them as before.
- **Hidden categories.** A folder in more than one hidden category now shows as soon as any one of them is switched on in the filters. It used to need all of them.
- **Scene tags filter.** The list of scene tags in the scene filters was empty unless you kept a mastertags.txt file. It now offers every tag your scenes have. **Edit Scenes**, for tagging several scenes at once, offers them too.

## Changes

- In the scene filters, **Folder tag** now comes before **Scene tags**.
- A new install has no Favourites folder set, so the first Sync 5-Star Scenes to Favourites asks where to copy to. A folder you've already chosen is kept.
